name: ToxGIN
dependencies: PyTorch, DGL, transformers, tokenizers, Biopandas, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; the optional PyG interface also requires PyG
scope: Source release containing training/prediction code, original data, and static input definitions. Model weights, caches, and historical outputs are excluded.
notes: The DGL CSV interface corresponds to the historical training implementation; evaluate_toxgin_pyg.py provides a separate compatible inference implementation. Historical attempts and caches are not bundled.
